_comment: Offline plausibility table shipped with every bundle. Per-measure sane bounds for a POOLED clinical effect and its CI. These are deliberately wide: they exist to catch impossible/divergent numbers (e.g. a runaway tau2 giving a CI spanning many orders of magnitude), not to second-guess a legitimate large effect. Ratio measures (RR/OR/HR/IRR) are bounded away from 0 and infinity; a real pooled treatment effect essentially never falls outside [0.05, 20]. max_ci_width_ratio is the upper/lower CI ratio; a genuine meta-analytic CI rarely spans more than ~50x.
_source: advanced-stats rules + empirical bounds over the RapidMeta corpus; conservative by design
